unopenableDocument.heading: This document cannot be edited in the visual editor.
unopenableDocument.condition: The visual editor can open a document only when it contains exactly one <body> start tag followed by exactly one </body> end tag.
unopenableDocument.forbiddenTag: This document cannot be opened because its body contains a <{tagName}> element.
unopenableDocument.encodingMismatch: Some characters in this document could not be read with the current encoding. In the text editor, run Reopen with Encoding to choose the file's encoding, then open the document in the visual editor again.
documentSkeleton.failed.message: The visual editor could not create the HTML skeleton, so the file was left unchanged.
documentUnreadable.message: The visual editor could not read this file, so nothing was loaded and the file was left unchanged.
sendFailure.heading: Your edits couldn't be sent to the extension.
sendFailure.description: Your edits haven't reached the extension. You can't continue editing until you retry.
editCaptureFailure.description: Editing stopped because the visual editor couldn't record the edit state needed for undo. Reload the view to continue.
saveFailed.message: The visual editor could not save this file, so the file was left unchanged.
revertFailed.message: The visual editor could not revert this file. Your edits in the view are still there.
syncFailed.message: The visual editor could not read this file, so it could not synchronize. Neither the file nor the view was changed.
bufferFollowTimeout.message: The visual editor could not confirm that its last write reached this file. Your edits are still in the view; use Save As to write them to another file.
textBufferDirty.message: The text editor for this file has unsaved edits, so the visual editor did not save it. Save the text editor first.
documentApplyFailed.message: The visual editor could not apply the content to the view, so the file was left unchanged.
historyFlushFailed.message: The visual editor could not commit your latest input, so the operation was not performed. The content in the view is unchanged.
historyApplyFailed.message: The visual editor could not apply the undo or redo to the view. Neither the file nor the view was changed.
historyProtected.message: The visual editor stopped editing, saving, and undo/redo to protect your content. You need to recover the document to continue.
backup.refreshFailed.message: The visual editor could not update the backup of your unsaved edits. It will try again on your next edit.
backup.savedFromRetainedCopy.message: The view did not respond, so the visual editor saved the file with the latest content it was holding.
protection.preserved.message: The visual editor backed up the protected content. Run Recover to write the backed-up content to the file and reopen the document.
protection.preservationFailed.message: The visual editor could not back up the protected content. Use Save As to write it to another file.
protection.closedWithBackup.message: A protected document was closed. The backed-up content remains in the extension's storage ({location}).
protection.closedWithoutBackup.message: A protected document was closed. Its content could not be backed up, so no unsaved edits remain.
recovery.completed.message: The backed-up content was written to the file and the document was reopened.
recovery.aborted.message: Recovery was stopped. The backed-up content is still there, so you can run Recover again.
recovery.reopenFailed.message: The backed-up content was written to the file, but the document could not be reopened. Reopen the file. The backed-up content also remains in the extension's storage ({location}).
recovery.sourceChanged.message: Recovery stopped without overwriting because the file changed after the recovery write. Use Save As to write your content to another file.
restore.failed.message: The visual editor has not finished restoring from the backup, so editing and saving are stopped. The backup remains in the extension's storage ({location}).
restore.failedWithoutLocation.message: The visual editor has not finished restoring from the backup, so editing and saving are stopped. The backup remains in the extension's storage.
restore.dirtyStateKept.message: The backup was discarded, but the unsaved indicator on the tab could not be cleared. The file was left unchanged.
restore.dirtyStateKeptWithoutBackup.mess: There was no backup to restore, but the unsaved indicator on the tab could not be cleared. The file was left unchanged.
restore.revertBlocked.message: The file cannot be reverted because restoring from the backup has not finished. The backup remains in the extension's storage ({location}).
restore.discardRecordFailed.message: The visual editor could not record the discard of a backup that is no longer needed. The backup remains in the extension's storage ({location}).
restore.deleteFailed.message: The visual editor could not delete a backup that is no longer needed. It will try again the next time it starts ({location}).
restoreFailure.heading: Your unsaved edits couldn't be restored from the backup.
restoreFailure.backupUnreadable: The backup couldn't be read. If retrying doesn't open it, discard the backup to open the file's current contents.
restoreFailure.sourceUnavailable: A text editor for this file has unsaved edits, or the file couldn't be read. Save or revert the file in the text editor, then retry.
restoreFailure.displayFailed: The restored content couldn't be displayed in this view. If retrying doesn't display it, open the file in the default text editor.
restoreFailure.connectionFailed: The restored content couldn't be carried over as unsaved edits. The backup has been kept.
restoreFailure.discardFailed: The discard of the backup couldn't be recorded. Please try again.
openInWysiwyg.failed.message: The file could not be opened in the visual editor, so the current tab was left unchanged.
openInHtml.failed.message: The file could not be opened in the text editor, so the current tab was left unchanged.
splitEditor.unavailable.message: The visual editor can show a file in only one tab, so the file was not opened in the new editor group.

relativeLink.unresolvable.message: The link could not be opened because it is not a valid file path.
relativeLink.outsideScope.message: The link could not be opened because its target is outside the workspace folder (or this file's folder, if the file is outside the workspace).
relativeLink.notFound.message: The link could not be opened because its target does not exist.
relativeLink.notFile.message: The link could not be opened because its target is not a file.
relativeLink.openFailed.message: The link could not be opened.
relativeLink.noWorkspaceFolder.message: The link could not be opened because links starting with "/" open from the workspace folder, and this file is not in one.
linkDialog.urlUnsafe: This URL cannot be used for a link.

imageDialog.sourceUnsafe: This value cannot be used for an image.

imageDialog.heightInvalid: Enter the height as a whole number of 1 or more, optionally followed by px or %.

conflictResolution.heading: Your edits conflict with changes made to the file.
conflictResolution.description: Choose what to keep for each conflict. The file is saved after you choose.
conflictResolution.changedAgain: The file changed again while you were choosing. Choose again for these conflicts.
conflictResolution.waiting.message: Saving {name} is waiting for you to choose what to keep for each conflict in the visual editor.
conflictResolution.canceled.message: {name} was not saved, so the visual editor still has unsaved edits. You can keep editing or close it without saving.
